difficulty_reason: The authors establish a new semi-broken-circuit deletion–contraction recursion and purity proof, then construct two complementary degree components in a projective flat degeneration of the semi-inverted variety. A radical equidimensional degree comparison upgrades circuit initial-monomial inclusion to equality, giving a universal basis for every monomial order. These matroidal degeneration constructions exceed routine circuit elimination or one-order Buchberger calculations; their full author proofs are retained, while named standard prerequisites remain uncounted context.
